title: Chapter 253: Two Victories
content:
Chapter 253: Two Victories

The Light Griffin Knights of the Alien Tribe were heavily bound by the trapping nets of the Zerg Queen. Under the powerful anti-aircraft firepower of the Zerg army, they all fell to the ground.

The Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Dragons continued to attack, and beat all the Light Griffin Knights on the ground to death before they stopped attacking.

The Zerg Queen added several layers of trapping nets to completely bind the severely damaged Light Griffin Knights and Giant Light Griffins of the Alien Tribe, so that they could no longer make any movements, and then they felt relieved.

The Zerg Queen needs time to recover, and they will continue to use parasitic control to control the Light Griffin Knights and Giant Light Griffins.

The five-star Zerg Destroyers were targeted by the Light Griffin Knights of the Alien Tribe, and the number of deaths exceeded 100. The others were also severely damaged. If they want to regain combat capability, they need some time to recover.

In this battle, to some extent, the Alien Tribe has achieved their strategic goal. Two thousand five-star Zerg Destroyers, hundreds of them died, and the rest all lost their combat capability.

If the Zerg is a normal race in this world, then these five-star Zerg destroyers will definitely not be able to recover their combat power in a short period of time, and it will be even more difficult to increase the number of five-star Zerg destroyers.

In this way, in the next battle between the Zerg army and the alien race, the chances of the alien race winning will be greatly improved.

Unfortunately, the Zerg is not a normal race in this world. The mysterious human knight who was rescued by the alien race should not have seen the scene of the Zerg army upgrading at any time on the battlefield yesterday.

Otherwise, the alien race would not have gone to such great lengths to create such a big battle just to eliminate these two thousand five-star Zerg destroyers.

Without two thousand five-star Zerg destroyers, the firepower output of the Zerg army was much weaker, and the killing efficiency of the alien race's affiliated army was greatly reduced, which made the offensive of the army commanded by the alien race begin to become stronger again.

Wu Qing obtained the luck beads from the Naga battlefield to upgrade the Zerg destroyers. The profits earned could be used to upgrade nine thousand five-star Zerg destroyers, but he did not do so for the time being.

The aliens have gone to great lengths to defeat the five-star destroyers in the Zerg army. If the five-star Zerg destroyers in the Zerg army are restored immediately, I don’t know what the aliens will do.

Moreover, with this upgrade, the goblins and the armies of the affiliated races of the aliens who are attacking the Zerg army head-on may retreat. These resources that are delivered to the door cannot be let go just like that.

The five-star Zerg destroyers will not be upgraded for the time being, but the number of four-star Zerg destroyers can be appropriately increased.

There are also four-star strengths in the Zerg Hydralisk, Zerg Cockroach, Zerg Dragon and Zerg Stealth Spider. The number can be appropriately increased, which can greatly enhance the combat power of the Zerg army, but it will not scare the aliens.

The Zerg army has been upgraded to four-star units to join the battle, and the situation has been reversed again. The four-star Zerg destroyers specifically attack the armies of the alien races.

Other four-star units also focus on the armies of the alien races. With the addition of two thousand five-star Zerg Hydralisks and two thousand five-star Zerg Mutalisks, the armies of the alien races are quickly exhausted.

In order to wait for the Zerg Queen to parasitize and control the Light Griffin Knights and Giant Light Griffins, the Zerg army continues to stay and fight with the endless stream of Goblins.

The aliens thought that their strategic goal had been achieved. When they found that the armies of the affiliated races had been completely lost and had not broken through the Zerg army's defense line, they no longer insisted on destroying the Zerg army here.

The offensive of the goblins also weakened. The scattered goblins attacked, and it felt like they were just harassing, and they were no longer a threat to the Zerg army.

The Zerg Queen can control two hundred Light Griffin Knights or Giant Light Griffins after recovering once.

Wu Qing took out the Heavenly Silkworm from the transport host for the Light Griffin Knight and the Giant Light Griffin that the Zerg Queen successfully controlled, and asked them to swallow it, and let them switch to the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformation Technique on the spot.

Wu Qing also took out the Zerg energy coins and let them absorb the pure energy to recover their injuries and strength.

The five-star Light Griffin Knight and the Giant Light Griffin switched to the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformation Technique, which was fast and effective, and they could continue to use the familiar light attribute energy and martial arts and magic without changing their cultivation energy attributes, and their combat power would not be weakened.

The rapid replenishment of light attribute energy can quickly heal their injuries, and it won't take long for them to move freely.

When all the Light Griffin Knights and Giant Light Griffins were parasitized and controlled by the Zerg Queen, successfully switched to the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformation Technique, and had the ability to move independently, the Zerg army began to march again under the harassment of the goblins.

The parasitic light griffon knights continued to stay with their giant light griffon mounts, and with those giant light griffons that no longer had knights, they followed the Zerg army on foot on the ground.

Together with the giant light griffons controlled by the Zerg Queen yesterday and ten alien knights, their team gradually grew stronger.

Wu Qing did not let the giant light griffons fly, in addition to the reason that they were injured, he also did not want to further provoke the aliens. Now keep a low profile, and wait until the Zerg base is established here, then they will be fearless.

“Boom boom boom…!”

As the Zerg destroyers fired from time to time, the Zerg army began to march at full speed. Wu Qing hoped that the Zerg army could reach the 66th city before dark.

Niu Zhong and the elite Niu cavalry led by him watched the battle throughout and had no chance to participate in this war.

It was the first time they saw so many alien light griffin knights go out together. In the past, the alien army would not send such a number of light griffin knights to participate in the battle even if it was against the large tribe army of the local camp.

Unexpectedly, the Zerg army not only successfully resisted this terrible attack, but also seemed to have captured a large number of alien light griffin knights. This was an unprecedented feat!

Many people were paying attention to every move of the Zerg army. The performance of the Zerg army here would be quickly transmitted back to the main city, and then from the main city to various places.

"The aliens spared no expense and sent thousands of light griffin knights to successfully defeat the five-star ultra-long-range attack troops in the Zerg army!"

"What would the aliens think if they knew that these five-star troops in the Zerg army were temporarily upgraded before the battle yesterday!"

"Haha! The Zerg are really cunning. They stopped attacking after their five-star troops were defeated a little. They are trying to mislead the aliens!"

"This alien ignored his status and went to the battlefield himself. Now he has met his match!"

"Have you noticed that the Zerg army captured Those Light Griffin Knights of the Alien Clan seem to be controlled! "

"Each major clan has its own means of control. It is not surprising to control some soldiers of the Evil God Camp!"

"However, the soldiers of the Evil God Camp have an extremely firm belief, and they will eventually be killed!"

"I heard that this Zerg is a new race. Maybe they think they have the ability to control these evil god believers!"

"If you don't try it yourself, you will always be unwilling!"

"..."

The strong men from all parties who are responsible for observing the Zerg army have seen the battlefield performance of the Zerg army.

On the Zerg army's marching road behind, only the goblins are constantly harassing, and no other alien army appears.

...

On the public battlefield of the southern theater, a great battle between the Zerg army and the Alien Clan has ended, and the great battle of the Naga Clan battlefield is also coming to an end.

Five thousand five-star Zerg destroyers, led by nearly 300,000 Zerg destroyers, use the most intense ultra-long-range firepower to block the retreat of the Skeleton Clan army.

Nearly two million retreating Skeletons constantly tried to use various methods to attack the tight firepower network built by the Zerg Destroyers. Every time they were about to succeed, they would be destroyed by the concentrated fire attack of 5,000 five-star Zerg Destroyers.

The attack power of 5,000 five-star Zerg Destroyers was too strong, and their attacks restrained the Skeletons. No organized Skeleton army could withstand their attacks.

Three hundred and five thousand Zerg Destroyers of other strengths, except for a small number of them supporting the Naga army and the Skeleton army, the firepower of the remaining troops was enough to cover the entire retreat of the Skeleton army.

From the beginning of the war to the present, all Skeleton armies were covered by the attacks of the Zerg Destroyers. Except for those particularly powerful arms, the one-star Skeleton soldiers who occupied the vast majority of the troops were all injured.

Such injuries on the Skeleton soldiers were not enough to offset the restraining damage of the Zerg Destroyers' attacks, even with the recovery blessing of the Death Mist.

Therefore, the further back you go, the weaker the defense of ordinary Skeleton soldiers will be, and the more difficult it will be to break through the firepower net of the Zerg destroyers.

After losing a large number of troops, the Skeleton Army finally decided to abandon most of the Skeleton soldiers, and those powerful Skeleton troops broke through and escaped alone.

The Zerg Host, Zerg Queen and Zerg Destroyer worked together in real time, exerting the most powerful combat efficiency, especially increasing the killing efficiency of the five-star Zerg Destroyer to the extreme, so that those powerful Skeleton troops fell under the firepower net of the Zerg Destroyer in large numbers.

There were only a few real strong Skeleton troops who could finally break through the firepower net of the Zerg Destroyer.

For these strong men, without the Zerg Queen, the Zerg Destroyer alone was powerless.

The other Skeleton troops were quickly eliminated with the cooperation of the Zerg Destroyer and the Naga Army.

In this battle, the Naga tribe almost wiped out the five million elite troops of the Skeleton tribe at a very small cost, and achieved a huge victory that they had never dared to imagine before!
